newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cathay says has no firm alliance plans.
newsitem.headline: Cathay says has no firm alliance plans.

text.p: Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd said it had no firm plans to enter an alliance with another airline although it has regular talks with other carriers, including UAL Corp's United Airlines.
"We are always studying what -- if anything -- we should do about alliances," Kwan Chuk-fai, manager of corporate communications, told Reuters on Thursday.
"We have business partnerships in various areas (with other airlines) but we don't have any firm plan to go into any such alliance with other carriers," Kwan added.

The South China Morning Post on Thursday quoted sources as saying United Airlines officials were understood to have talked about an alliance with Cathay and a possible increase in fees at Hong Kong's new airport during a recent visit to the territory.

The newspaper said discussions were at an early stage but Cathay could be interested in tapping into United's extensive north American network, while United would like to win access to East Asia's extensive route possibilities through some form of alliance with Cathay.
